description: Returns the full SVG source of one Glyfiq icon as a single text content block. Requires the exact icon name returned by search_icons. Free icons work without a key. Premium icons require a valid license: if the license_key parameter is omitted, the key configured on the server (connector URL or Authorization header) is used automatically. If the icon is not found, the tool returns an error telling you to call search_icons. Without a valid key, a PRO icon returns an error with upgrade information.

license_key.description: Required only for PRO icons. Usually set once in the connector URL instead.

name.description: Exact icon name as returned by search_icons

name: get_icon_svg
title: Get icon SVG code
